FULL TEXT:
DEPARTMENT OF LAWS PANJAB UNIVERSITY, CHANDIGARH
INTERVIEW FOR THE POST OF GUEST FACULTY IN DEPARTMENT OF
LAWS, PANJAB UNIVERSITY, CHANDIGARH.
Posts No. of seats Honorarium
Guest Faculty (Law) 03 Rs. 1500/- per lecture subject to maximum of Rs.
50,000/- per month
The appointment of the aforesaid post is to teach LL.B and LL.M. classes in the Department
of Laws, Panjab University, Chandigarh.
Minimum Qualification: Master’s degree with55%marks (50% marks in case of SC/ST) or
an equivalent grade in a point-scale wherever the grading system is followed) and UGC-NET
or Ph.D. in Law, as per UGC REGULATIONS ON MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS FOR
APPOINTMENT OF TEACHERS AND OTHER ACADEMIC STAFF IN UNIVERSITIES
AND COLLEGES AND MEASURES FOR THE MAINTENANCE OF STANDARDS IN
HIGHER EDUCATION, 2018.
All the applicants are advised to send/submit their applications to the Department of Laws,
Panjab University, Chandigarh along with all self attested copies of their certificates and
other relevant documents including publications for verification along with the duly filled
application form and template pages 1 to 11available at:
https://forms.puchd.ac.in/forms/20200122155429-
directrecruitmentassistantprofessorapplicationformasperugcregulation2018.pdf on or before
14 November 2026, by 4:00 pm. (Late applications will not be considered).
Candidates are required to report on the date of interview which will be notified shortly.
Physical presence of the candidate is mandatory at the time of interview. Further, candidates
are required to bring all the supporting documents/certificates/publications in original.
The candidate shall have to give an undertaking that he/she will not draw any
fellowship/stipend or any financial assistance from any agency till they are teaching at
Department of Laws, Panjab University, Chandigarh as a Guest Faculty. The candidates are
requested to keep on checking the Panjab University and Department of Laws website for
further updates regarding interview date etc.
Sd /-
Chairperson
